pay_detail: $650. Some financial help may be available.
name: Horticultural Science Summer Institute
what_you_do: A week on campus doing hands-on plant work. You breed vegetables, grow new shrubs from cuttings and work with cut flowers. You visit farms, greenhouses and gardens. You also learn about college choices and leadership.
who_can_apply: Must be a high school student. The page does not say whether out-of-state students can apply.
deadline_text: 2026 session was July 5-10, 2026. Deadline was April 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Visit the program website to learn more and apply (growforit.ces.ncsu.edu/growforit-programs/hssi). The page does not list application steps.
